tools.name: check
tools.description: Run an approved public command by index in a disposable copy.

tools.name: focus
tools.description: Discover qualified symbols and read bounded source (60 lines, 3000 UTF-8 bytes). query is a case-insensitive literal substring of a qualified symbol or source line. Use symbol=Class.method for exact lookup. Follow next_line; unchanged repeated excerpts are suppressed.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Review a Git diff of current workspace edits.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Apply a SHORT exact source edit with current SHA-256 returned by source inspection. replace consumes old and inserts new. before/after KEEP old and insert new immediately before/after it; new is only the insertion, not old plus insertion. These modes require a unique literal old anchor, preserving all whitespace; new text is literal, including line endings. No fuzzy matching. create requires expected_sha256=absent and old empty. Errors return a source-region hint; reinspect and recover. Python results must parse.

limitation: Server health/catalog verified; upstream asynchronous registration is not guaranteed by this preflight.
